errors.evidence: The values for the 'Arbeitsplätze geschaffen' category are incorrect. The chart shows approximately 8-9% for 'produzierendes Gewerbe' (dark blue), and approximately 10% for 'öffentlicher Dienst' (grey). The machine description states 10% and 7% respectively, appearing to swap and misread the values.
